column2: A learning journey shown as three connected platforms rising left to right: a presentation screen, a practice keyboard with a glowing key, and a full code editor workstation. A winding path connects them.

Three connected rooms or states of a modal text editor: a calm navigation room with a compass, a typing room with a keyboard, and a selection room with a highlighted block of text, connected by arrows like a state diagram.
A cursor block hopping across rows of abstract text lines in precise arcs, with small trails showing jumps to line start, line end, next word and a matching bracket.
Two puzzle pieces snapping together: one piece is an action (scissors, eraser, copy icon) and the other is a direction arrow covering a stretch of text lines, forming a complete command.
Abstract text lines with pairs of brackets, quotes and parentheses; one inner region between a pair of brackets glows and is lifted out precisely, showing inside vs around.
A magnifying glass scanning rows of abstract text lines, with several matching blocks highlighted and one block being swapped for a new glowing block.
A row of small storage drawers holding text fragments, and a film reel recording a sequence of keystroke blocks that replays as a repeated pattern.
A screen divided into tiled panes like a terminal multiplexer: a code pane, a terminal pane on the right and another terminal pane at the bottom, with a cursor moving between panes.
A toolbox opening with a plug connecting a configuration folder to an editor window, with small gears and packages flowing into it.
A code editor window with a file tree, a glowing lightbulb hint beside a line, a branching git graph, and diagnostic markers in the gutter.
Several friendly abstract robot assistants in separate terminal panes editing documents, while a central editor window updates live with small refresh arrows.
Modular building blocks snapping onto a central editor core, each block a different shape and accent, arranged neatly.
Two different editor windows connected by a bridge, sharing the same keyboard below them, keys glowing identically on both sides.
A wrench and a stethoscope examining an editor window with a small warning sign, showing calm troubleshooting and a green check emerging.
